assistant.welcome: Hello! I am your ArkiWatch Data Explainer. Ask about weather, air quality, energy, traffic, sources, or what the current snapshot means — I answer from live platform data and stay on topic.
assistant.whichSourceAbnormal: Which data source is abnormal recently?
assistant.whichExpansionPlanned: What expansion directions are being planned?
assistant.askPlaceholder: Ask about current conditions, sources, or this page...
assistant.title: Data Assistant
assistant.subtitle: Data Explainer
assistant.whatShouldIDoToday: What should I pay attention to today?
assistant.bestTimeToGoOutside: When is the best time to go outside?
assistant.bestTimeToCommute: When should I plan my commute?
assistant.historicalMostRelevant: What mattered most on the selected date?
assistant.historicalBestWindow: When were conditions best on the selected date?
assistant.historicalChangedSignals: Which signals changed on the selected date?
assistant.failure: I could not reach the data assistant. Try again, or check the platform status before acting.
assistant.providerUnavailable: The AI provider is unavailable, so this answer uses grounded data only.
assistant.timedOut: The assistant took too long to respond. Try again or inspect the cited data.
assistant.rateLimited: The assistant is busy. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
assistant.rateLimitedSoon: The assistant is busy. Please try again shortly.
assistant.streamInterrupted: The AI response was interrupted; review the sources below before acting.
assistant.emptyResponse: The AI provider returned no answer, so this uses grounded data only.
assistant.offlinePrompt: Platform data is temporarily unavailable. Once the overview is healthy, I can assist you with telemetry charts and logs.
